Why is Xi Jinping not bad?
1LittleGranny64Author has many answers and views

I am Canadian, so my view may be a little different.

I believe this leader has made many changes possible for the country. There are still important problems to solve, but some areas have improved in recent decades.

There are serious questions about rights, pollution, and infrastructure. Those issues should remain part of any fair assessment of the results.

I would say that there has been considerable improvement in some areas.
